title: 🔴 MSFS 2024 | Sim Update 5 Beta Build 2: Testing fixes & new Avidyne variants! (1.7.7.0)
description:
Join us live as we dive into the 2nd build of the Sim Update 5 Beta (v1.7.7.0) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024! 🚀 We'll be flight testing the latest stability improvements, checking out the brand new Avidyne IFD540/550 for the Cessna 172, and seeing if those critical bug fixes are actually working! 🛠️

In this stream, we’re testing:

- New Aircraft Variants: First look at the C172 Skyhawk equipped with Avidyne IFD550/540! 🛩️
- System Fixes: Testing the GNS430/530 zoom buttons. 🖥️
- Graphics & Performance: Checking graphics and performance. 🎮
- Career Mode: Testing aircraft spawn fixes and the new taxi ribbons. 👨‍✈️
- World & VR: Verifying missing textures and VR preset loading. 🥽

Live Stream Schedule:
🗓️ Date: February 21st
⏰ Time: 7:00 PM UTC / 2:00 PM EST
